source_note: Keeper Rulebook scenario rewards may grant Sanity points using non-percentile reward dice; playtest logs must keep the roll id, die expression, total, and SAN before/delta/after together.

keeper_award.source_note: Keeper Rulebook p.168, 'Increasing Current Sanity Points' item 1 (Keeper award): at the end of a successful scenario or campaign chapter the Keeper may specify a Sanity reward roll, the same for all participants, proportional to the danger faced; cowardly, brutal or murderous investigators may have it reduced or removed. The book prints 1D6 as its example; the other rungs are this repository's scale around that example and are labelled so (contract §221.9).

scale.label: No award: the investigators were cowardly, brutal or murderous, or faced no real danger (p.168)
A lesser award than the book's example: modest danger faced (this scale, not printed)
The book's example award for a scenario's danger met (p.168)
A greater award than the book's example: grave danger faced and overcome (this scale, not printed)
